name: Schengen Visitor Visa / Visa-Free Entry

qualifying_event.description: Norway is a Schengen member (via association, not EU membership). Nationals of visa-exempt countries enter visa-free for short stays; others must obtain a Schengen (Type C) visitor visa from a Norwegian consulate before travel.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Passport; travel purpose documentation; proof of funds; return travel evidence; travel/health insurance.

requirements.blocker_text: Valid for entry to all Schengen countries for up to 90 days.

evidence_required.document: Proof of funds and return travel

sources.title: UDI (Norwegian Directorate of Immigration) -- Visitor visa: up to 90-day Schengen-wide validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway).
